name: What should I consider when choosing the size and shape of my kitchen peninsula?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing the size and shape of my kitchen peninsula?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing the size and shape of your kitchen peninsula, consider the available space to ensure adequate clearance for movement around it, especially in high-traffic areas. Also, think about its intended use: a larger surface is ideal for entertaining or serious cooking, while a smaller one might suffice for a breakfast bar. Our design team can help you balance aesthetics with practical space requirements to optimize flow and utility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider available space for clearance and the peninsula's intended use when choosing its size and shape to optimize kitchen flow.
